registeredBefore: any run on the held-out seeds below
scope: Bounded diagnostic evaluation of the ASCII Worlds 2.0 game suite. Not a Stage 3H experiment, not a competence certificate, not evidence of general intelligence. R0 local simulation only; frozen Stage 3F/3G artifacts untouched.

computeBudgets.INCUMBENT_ROOT_PUCT: src/prime/root-puct.js unchanged; 96 simulations; one-step horizon; KNOWN_SIMULATOR_DIAGNOSTIC access; tick caps pong 5000, platformer 1500, fighter 900, racing 1500 (runs beyond are CENSORED_BY_EVALUATION_BUDGET)
computeBudgets.pong SENTINEL: least-squares flight fit over <=18 observations; 1 projection per tick; horizon = ticks to intercept
computeBudgets.platformer SENTINEL: <=101 complete-trajectory rollouts x 45 ticks per decision when an obstacle is within 26 units; otherwise one 20-tick safety rollout
computeBudgets.fighter SENTINEL: <=35 macro options (14 when airborne) x <=5 opponent hypotheses x 28 ticks per actionable decision
computeBudgets.racing SENTINEL: 16 plans (4 aggression x 4 lateral) x 40 ticks per decision

metrics.SUCCESS_RATE: pong WIN share; platformer WIN (exit reached) share; fighter round WIN share; racing share finishing 1st
metrics.REWARD: mean episode sum of the explicit local shaped reward (not DDV, not comparable across games)
metrics.REGRET: one-step shaped-reward regret proxy sampled every 10 ticks; valid only as a one-step diagnostic, not as multi-step competence regret
metrics.DECISION_LATENCY: mean and p95 wall-clock ms per decision (diagnostic)
metrics.REPEATED_FAILURE_RATE: platformer: deaths/damage at an already-seen (checkpoint, section, cause) key over all damage; other games: share of episodes with a repeated identical failure class
metrics.ADAPTATION_RESPONSE: per Phase 5 condition: change relative to FIRST_ENCOUNTER, with the trigger types that explain it
metrics.OPPONENT_ROBUSTNESS: fighter win rate per archetype; pong score differential vs adaptive opponent; racing placement vs changed rivals
metrics.UNSEEN_SEED_PERFORMANCE: held-out seed results (all main tables use held-out seeds only)

classificationRules: Identical replays of a deterministic controller are DETERMINISTIC_REPETITION, never learning.
Behaviour change after failure counts as adaptation only when traceable to a logged trigger (failure signature, residual estimate, opponent-model shift, corner memory).
No controller in this suite updates weights; LEARNED_POLICY_ADAPTATION is not claimed for any controller.
The incumbent's KNOWN_SIMULATOR access is privileged diagnostic access, not deployable planning.

hypotheses.claim: Explicit failure memory reduces repeated deaths on unmodelled crosswind gaps.
hypotheses.success: SENTINEL repeatedDeathRate <= 0.2 AND SENTINEL completion >= SENTINEL_NO_MEMORY completion + 0.3

hypotheses.claim: Complete-trajectory planning outperforms the incumbent and the rule baseline.
Long-range prediction adds return-rate value beyond the analytic baseline only under delayed/noisy observation.
hypotheses.success: SENTINEL_FILTER_ONLY returnRate - ANALYTIC_INTERCEPT >= 0.10 in bands 4 and 5 AND |difference| <= 0.03 in bands 1 and 2

hypotheses.claim: Bounded shot selection improves score differential against the adaptive opponent.
hypotheses.failure: otherwise (development runs suggested this may fail)

hypotheses.success: mean 2-sigma coverage in [0.85, 0.99] and 1-sigma coverage in [0.55, 0.85]

hypotheses.claim: Option rollouts beat the rule baseline across archetypes.
hypotheses.success: SENTINEL round-win rate >= RULE_BASELINE + 0.2 AND higher mean damage efficiency for every archetype

hypotheses.claim: Sentinel does not tie guard, attack and movement; the one-step incumbent does.
The fighter advantage is not only reaction speed.
hypotheses.success: SENTINEL win rate >= 0.5 under delayed observation

hypotheses.claim: Rivals are comparably paced (no structural deficit).
hypotheses.success: mean finish spread (last car minus first car, ticks) <= 10% of the winner's race time AND RULE_BASED win share in [0.1, 0.6]

hypotheses.claim: MPC with the vehicle model beats the rule-based racer.
hypotheses.success: SENTINEL mean placement <= RULE_BASED - 0.3 AND SENTINEL off-track ticks <= RULE_BASED in both tiers

hypotheses.claim: Lap-to-lap corner memory reduces off-track time on wet tracks.
hypotheses.success: SENTINEL mean off-track ticks < SENTINEL_NO_MEMORY mean off-track ticks

analysisPlan: Report every controller separately per game and tier; no cross-game pooling; report failed hypotheses unchanged; no post-hoc criterion changes. Any later criterion change requires a new registration file and must be disclosed.
